description: android:usesCleartextTraffic set to true lets the app send unencrypted HTTP traffic. Google Play flags an app that transmits personal or sensitive data over an unencrypted connection.

remediation.summary: Set android:usesCleartextTraffic to false, and add a network security configuration with a per domain exception if one host still needs HTTP.

title: The app allows cleartext network traffic

description: android:allowBackup set to true copies app data into a cloud or local backup. An app that stores credentials or health data must turn the flag off or exclude those files with a backup rule.

remediation.summary: Set android:allowBackup to false, or list the files to exclude in a data extraction rules file.

title: Automatic backup is enabled

changelog.change: Compiled from google-play-target-api-level-requirements section Migrate from Android 10 (API level 29) to Android 11 (API level 30) at document version 20260901T173614601Z-35c84aed. Model confidence 0.55. Awaiting human review.
Verification lowered the severity from error to warning, because the check cannot support the stronger claim.

Verification graded this rule wrong_detection and named no fix that a pass can apply. A person must read it. Add a check for v2SigningEnabled==true (required) in addition to the existing v1SigningEnabled check, and treat the v1 check as advisory (warning) rather than error since policy uses 'should'.
Writing a rejection case showed the rule could not fire on the fault it names: the setting name carried a prefix the build file parser never produces.

Verification graded this rule wrong_detection and named no fix that a pass can apply. A person must read it. Add a check for v2SigningEnabled=true as required, in addition to checking v1SigningEnabled=true as recommended.
Verification named a fix that a pass could not apply: the rule read one half of the signing requirement.
Promoted. Verification graded it accurate, and it raises no error finding on any of the published apps that ran it.

description: Apps must be signed with APK Signature Scheme v2 (required) and should also continue signing with v1 for compatibility with older devices.

examples: signingConfigs { release { v1SigningEnabled true; v2SigningEnabled true } }
remediation.summary: In the app's build.gradle signing configuration, set both v1SigningEnabled and v2SigningEnabled to true.

source.section: Migrate from Android 10 (API level 29) to Android 11 (API level 30)

title: Continue signing with APK Signature Scheme v1 for backward compatibility
